Stanford [CS 336 — Language Modeling from Scratch](https://cs336.stanford.edu/), Spring 2026. Instructors: Tatsunori Hashimoto and Percy Liang.

The course walks through building a modern language model end-to-end: tokenization, architecture, optimization, parallel training, inference, scaling laws, data curation, and post-training alignment (SFT, RLHF, DPO, RL for reasoning).
